core_meaning.primary_meaning: Fidha is an Arabic-origin name meaning “To be wide, open”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Fidha corresponds to the Arabic form فِضا (Arabic root ف ض و (f-ḍ-w) 'to be wide, open'). Its core sense is liberated, free, independent. Fidha corresponds to Arabic فضاء (faḍāʾ) 'space, vastness, open expanse', from the root ف ض و. The name sense is 'openness, freedom, spaciousness'. The source gave the form فضى and glossed it 'liberated, free, independent'; the 'freedom' idea is an extension of 'open expanse' rather than a literal gloss. The closely related spelling Fiza (فِضا, fiḍā) is also current.

persian.name: فضا
persian.long_meaning: Fidha (فضا) نامی برگرفته از زبان عربی است و معنای اصلی آن آزاد، مستقل است. این نام در جوامع مسلمان به کار می‌رود و کاربرد آن بسته به بافت زبانی متفاوت است.
